source_state: measured from the byte-identical pre-commit candidate; solver source was subsequently committed without changes and the benchmark harness is archived with this evidence

protocol.timer_scope: separate direct force, Barnes-Hut tree build/force, and one complete Barnes-Hut Velocity Verlet step

limitations: Exploratory single-machine measurements, not frozen Stage 5 evidence.
Only three repetitions per configuration; scheduling, clocks, affinity, and thermals were uncontrolled.
The maximum per-body relative error is ill-conditioned where the direct acceleration is near zero; absolute, RMS, and percentile metrics must be inspected together.
Measurements preceded the source commit; the recorded solver commit contains the byte-identical implementation, while this evidence record archives the harness and raw hash.
